title: 第九章 被偷走的回信，等不回的人
novel_title: 救命！我的神煞师父怎么天天亲我
content_zh:
“正是这里的环境管理员，林大柄。”

    他们说这些话的时候，林大柄正好巡视回来，在门口听到了一切，他站在门外，攥着拳头，眼眶微红。

    当听到这最后两句话时，林大柄猛地推开值班室的门，大声喊道：“我不是负心汉！”

    几人盯着林大柄，神色各异，傅烬川抬眸看他，眼神冷冽，没有多说。

    人都是自私的，他也不例外，但他的父母恩爱非常，对他影响很大，所以无法理解感情中的背叛，更是对这类人嗤之以鼻。

    林大柄在他的气势压迫下收敛了情绪，望向一边的虚白，眼神充满祈求，声音颤抖：“大师，能不能带我去见见她……”

    虚白在得到了傅烬川的首肯后，才敢带林大柄离开，“跟我来吧。”

    姜无念早已等在岸边，见两人过来，对着他们挥了挥手。

    哎……真是世事无常大肠包小肠，怎么她找的时候就找不到呢？

    林大柄看见她有些惊讶，但他现在满心都是王素仪，已经没有心情想这些了。

    他对着空旷的水面来回扫视，疑惑地看向虚白，“大师，她在哪儿？”

    虚白从随身的口袋里拿出一瓶透明液体，涂抹在林大柄眼皮上，“这是‘牛眼泪’，你等两分钟再睁开眼就能看见了。”

    两分钟很快就过去了，江面泛起冷雾，王素仪的身影缓缓浮现，长发湿黏，眼神空洞，周身裹着淡淡鬼气。

    林大柄眼皮颤抖，始终不敢睁开，直到耳畔传来一声令他朝思暮想的声音。

    “你是谁？”

    听到久违的声音，林大柄瞬间红了眼眶，眼泪顿时夺眶而出，双拳在身侧紧握，胸膛不断起伏着。

    他努力深呼吸让自己得以冷静下来，缓缓睁眼。

    这是他守在这里二十几年第一次见到王素仪，颤抖着向她伸出手，轻声开口叫出了那个心心念念的名字：

    “素仪……”

    王素仪用陌生的目光看向林大柄，“你是谁？我不认识你。”

    林大柄神情有些落寞。
content_en:
"It's the environmental manager here, Lin Daying."

    When they were saying these words, Lin Daying happened to come back from his inspection and heard everything at the door. He stood outside the door with clenched fists and red eyes.

    When he heard these last two sentences, Lin Dabing slammed open the door of the duty room and shouted: "I am not a heartless person!"

    Several people stared at Lin Daying with different expressions. Fu Jinchuan looked up at him with cold eyes and said nothing.

    People are selfish, and he is no exception, but his parents are very loving and have a great influence on him, so he cannot understand betrayal in relationships, and he even scorns such people.

    Lin Dabiang restrained his emotions under the pressure of his momentum and looked to Xu Bai aside, his eyes full of prayer and his voice trembling: "Master, can you take me to see her..."

    Only after getting Fu Jinchuan's approval did Xu Bai dare to take Lin Dabiang away, "Come with me."

    Jiang Wunian had already been waiting on the shore. When he saw the two people approaching, he waved to them.

    Sigh... things are really unpredictable, so why can't she find it when she looks for it?

    Lin Daying was a little surprised to see her, but now his heart was full of Wang Suyi and he was no longer in the mood to think about this.

    He glanced back and forth at the empty water and looked at Xu Bai in confusion, "Master, where is she?"

    Xu Bai took out a bottle of transparent liquid from his pocket and smeared it on Lin Dadian's eyelids, "These are 'cow tears'. You can see them after two minutes when you open your eyes."

    Two minutes passed quickly, and a cold mist appeared on the river. Wang Suyi's figure slowly emerged, with long sticky hair, hollow eyes, and a faint ghostly aura around her body.

    Lin Dadian's eyelids trembled, and he never dared to open them, until a sound came from his ears that made him think about it day and night.

    "Who are you?"

    Hearing the long-lost voice, Lin Dabiang's eyes instantly turned red, and tears burst out of his eyes. His fists were clenched at his sides, and his chest kept rising and falling.

    He took a deep breath to calm down and slowly opened his eyes.

    This was the first time he saw Wang Suyi after staying here for more than 20 years. He stretched out his hand to her tremblingly and softly called out the name that he had been thinking about so much:

    "Suyi..."

    Wang Suyi looked at Lin Daying with unfamiliar eyes, "Who are you? I don't know you."

    Lin Dabiang looked a little lonely.
title_en: Chapter 9 The stolen reply, the person who cannot wait for the reply
